title: Trusted resumable native ecbench computation and one fresh L2 epoch, or a command-mode computation with output upload

deadline_unix_seconds.description: Original absolute UTC deadline; never reset by retries. New runs need 180..86400 seconds.

ecbench_sha256.description: SHA-256 of /usr/local/bin/ecbench; in command mode, of the image file command.argv[0].

runtime_image_uri.description: Trusted recovery layer over the build image. The native binary hash must match build.ecbench_sha256.

spec.description: Required for ecbench requests: original ecbench.spec/v1 requiring L2, warmup >=1, rounds >=5, reference and matching A/A. Native controller and ecbench apply semantic validation. Absent or null in command mode.

max_restores.description: 1..5 for ecbench requests; up to 50 only when command is present.

command.description: Optional command mode. The trusted supervisor execs argv as UID 1000 without capabilities and with perf_event_open denied, instead of isolab-criu-progress+ecbench; CRIU/EBS checkpoint, fencing, restore and deadline are unchanged. There is no native replay and no fresh L2 epoch: after the command exits (any code is recorded, never retried) the outputs directory, run.stdout, run.stderr and SHA256SUMS are uploaded and the run ends command_completed. Timing is never admitted (L0). Not yet live-qualified; see CONTROLLER.md.

argv.description: argv[0] is a normalized absolute path inside the image (not under /work, /request, /proc, /sys, /dev or /tmp); build.ecbench_sha256 binds its SHA-256.

outputs.description: Normalized directory under /work/compute, not tmp, run.stdout or run.stderr. Exported to the payload as ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR.

threads.description: RAYON_NUM_THREADS for the payload. Explicit 1 canonicalizes to omission.

binaries.description: Further absolute image paths (not argv[0]) and their SHA-256, verified before launch and before every restore.

pvc_gib.description: Computation PVC size in GiB for every attempt, including PVCs cloned from checkpoint snapshots. Explicit 8 canonicalizes to omission.

memory.description: Shared computation and fresh L2 memory request/limit. Omission preserves legacy 4Gi request identity; 8Gi must be explicit.

raw_json.description: Exact decoded UTF-8 launch bytes; native validation also enforces a 65536-byte bound.

diagnostic_transport.description: Optional independently frozen computation-L0 and fresh-L2 launches. Native validation preserves the 65536-byte total request cap and verifies all exact-byte hashes.
